headline:
Selling In South Metro
Atlanta Listings Down 26.5%
turn_1: Echo, in metro Atlanta, new listings in the four weeks ending October 25 were down 26.5% from a year ago.
turn_2: So sellers have fewer new homes to compete with?
turn_3: Fewer new homes, yes. Homes going under contract were down 25.9% over the same four weeks, so the two slowed together.
echo_line: Two numbers almost the same size. I noticed that one all by myself.
source: Redfin weekly housing report · four weeks ending Oct 25, 2026 · released Oct 29, 2026
disclaimer: Metro Atlanta figures compared with a year earlier, not a valuation of any home. Results differ by county, price range and condition.
